config.name: imo-shortlist-2016-c4
config.statement:
Given $n = {n}$, fill the cells of an $n \times n$ table with one of the letters $I,M$ and $O$ in such a way that:
(i) in each row and each column, one third of the entries are $I$, one third are $M$ and one third are $O$; and
(ii) in any diagonal, if the number of entries on the diagonal is a multiple of three, then one third of the entries are $I$, one third are $M$ and one third are $O$.
config.formatting_instructions: Output the answer between \verb|\begin{array}{...}| and \verb|\end{array}| inside of $\boxed{...}$. For example, $\boxed{\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6 \\ 7 & 8 & 9\end{array}}$.

response.content:
To satisfy the conditions given in the problem, we need to construct a $9 \times 9$ table where each row, column, and relevant diagonals contain exactly three $I$s, three $M$s, and three $O$s. We will achieve this by creating a pattern that repeats every 3 rows and columns. This ensures that each row, column, and diagonal (when its length is a multiple of 3) will have an equal distribution of $I$s, $M$s, and $O$s.

Here's a possible construction:

\[
\boxed{\begin{array}{ccccccccc}
I & M & O & I & M & O & I & M & O \\
M & O & I & M & O & I & M & O & I \\
O & I & M & O & I & M & O & I & M \\
I & M & O & I & M & O & I & M & O \\
M & O & I & M & O & I & M & O & I \\
O & I & M & O & I & M & O & I & M \\
I & M & O & I & M & O & I & M & O \\
M & O & I & M & O & I & M & O & I \\
O & I & M & O & I & M & O & I & M \\
\end{array}}
\]

In this solution, the pattern $IMOMOMIMO$ is repeated in each row and column, ensuring that every row and column has exactly three $I$s, three $M$s, and three $O$s. Additionally, all diagonals whose lengths are multiples of 3 will also have an equal distribution of $I$s, $M$s, and $O$s due to the repeating nature of the pattern.
